The 2026–27 Premier Play Season, is the thirty-second Pro Tour season for Magic: The Gathering. The season opens with Regional Championships at the end of September 2026 and ends with the 2027 World Championship.

Arena Championship 13

Arena Championship 13 takes place on October 24–25, 2026. The format is Standard Constructed.[4] 178 players qualified to participate.

Pro Tour Nauctis

The first Pro Tour of 2027 takes place on February 26–28, 2027, at MagicCon Denver, USA.[6] The format is Nauctis: The Sunken Realm Draft and Modern Constructed.

Second Pro Tour

The second Pro Tour of 2027 takes place on May 14–16, 2027, at MagicCon Tokyo, Japan.[6] The format is Draft and Standard Constructed.

Magic Limited Championship

The Magic Limited Championship will take place June 18–20, 2027, in Minneapolis, Minnesota. This is a special event.[7][6]

Third Pro Tour

The third Pro Tour of 2027 takes place on August 27–29, 2027, at MagicCon Las Vegas, USA.[6] The format is Draft and Standard Constructed.

Magic World Championship

World Championship 33 takes place December 3–5, 2027, at MagicCon Amsterdam in the Netherlands.[6] The format is Draft and Standard Constructed.
